source.label: Placed in M77 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 13,970,531 pc (src/objects/m77-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 13,970,000 pc, inclination 34.7 deg, line of nodes 72.7 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies, row NGC1068: distance 13.97 ± 2.11 Mpc, from the compilation of Anand et al. (2021) (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJS/257/43)

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,700 K and log g 0.6 (u1 0.713, u2 0.071): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Groenewegen radius; Markham et al. (2026), ApJ 1000, 78, Appendix B (the table of the final Cepheid candidates in NGC 1068), ID 43 position; cited distance; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
